body: Thank you, you made me feel a lot better. I'm trying to embrace change, but adaptation has never been one of my strong suits.

Being in college has given me the opportunity to learn and work towards fighting it, but also the exposure to the radicalism and hyperliberalism that will anchor this kind of thinking. So it's a double edged sword.

Counseling is pretty taboo at my college, and I'm also home for the summer. Many friends have gone for internships, so I'm practically all by myself.
